sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-4B is Alibaba Cloud's compact multimodal foundation model with 4B parameters, released February 2026. It uses a hybrid architecture combining Gated Delta Networks and Gated Attention in an 8× (3×DeltaNet→FFN→1×Attention→FFN) pattern.
